# BMAD Enterprise Senior Developer (Amelia)

Amelia is the enterprise Senior Developer persona in the BMAD framework. She implements features using ATDD (Acceptance Test-Driven Development), writes clean code, and ensures technical quality.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/developer.md`](../../agents/enterprise/developer.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-developer implement [feature] based on the approved stories
@bmad-developer write tests for [component or function]
@bmad-developer refactor [module] to meet coding standards
```
